internal.title: Incident Report: Cart Service High Error Rate and Latency
internal.body:
On 2026-11-08 at 12:08 UTC, the cart service experienced a high error rate of 12% accompanied by elevated p95 latency of 0.25 seconds. This latency issue was identified as the primary cause of the errors. CPU utilization was elevated but below critical thresholds, and memory leak was ruled out as a cause.

Actions taken included disabling the cartFailure flag at 12:27 UTC, which led to recovery and normalization of service metrics. The incident was resolved promptly with no lasting impact on service availability.

Timeline:
- 12:08:03: Alert received for high error rate and latency.
- 12:27:43: Diagnosis confirmed latency as root cause.
- 12:27:49: Disabled cartFailure flag.
- 12:27:49: Recovery verified with stable latency and error rates.

Lessons learned and action items are documented to prevent recurrence.

external.title: Intermittent Cart Service Errors Resolved
external.body: Between 12:08 and 12:28 UTC on November 8, some customers experienced intermittent errors when using the cart service due to increased latency. The issue was identified and resolved quickly, and normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and are taking steps to prevent similar issues in the future.
